overclaims: There is firsthand evidence that simple prompting made Bing produce serious conspiracy misinformation during March, after Microsoft introduced restrictions.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, criteria, outcome (unresolved), and citations are accurate. The problem is the rationale's 'during March'. e2 dates only the follow-up, which says the behavior was blocked as of March 28 (posted 3/29). Neither the evidence item nor its context dates PopSci's earlier successful Bing tests. So nothing shows they fell inside the March 1–April 2 target period, or even after the Feb 17 restrictions. Either cite the date of the original test or article, or remove the March timing.
